audience: local businesses that collect customer reviews and show them on their website with Reviewshake

useCases.title: Read recent reviews by rating or location
useCases.text: List reviews, newest first, filtered by rating, location, review source or date. List the locations to find a location slug.

useCases.title: Check whether a customer was invited
useCases.text: List the review invitations that were sent, for one client when needed. Use the result to see if a customer was already invited.

useCases.title: Invite a customer to leave a review
useCases.text: Subscribe one customer by email or phone to a review campaign. Reviewshake then contacts that person, so send it only when the account owner asks.

useCases.title: Stop review invitations for a customer
useCases.text: Unsubscribe one customer, found by email or phone. The customer stops receiving review invitations.

useCases.title: Add a review widget to the website
useCases.text: List the widgets on the account, then create a widget of the chosen type. A widget is public once it is embedded on a site.
